prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create one 1024×1536 vertical full-body everyday illustration of the same adult woman as the reference images. Image 1 is the prior everyday scene; image 2 supplies her front-facing face identity and its exact rendering style. Place her sitting cross-legged on the roller-rink floor, with shoulders, torso and face directly front-on toward the camera. Both eyes clearly visible and looking at the viewer. Keep her exact face, amber eye colour, chestnut hairstyle, skin tone, proportions and reference rendering style. Dress her in a fully opaque, loose, high-neck long-sleeved blouse in the same pale colour and a long opaque skirt in the original skirt colour covering her legs to her ankles, with the same shoes. This is a calm ordinary fully clothed seated portrait. The entire seated figure, both natural hands and both feet fit within the image with clear margins and rink surroundings. Right hand on knee and left palm on floor. One woman, natural anatomy, no text or logos, no armour or regalia.
